verdict.rationale: Reducto's quickstart and config docs show code calling a first-party client object (`client.parse.run(...)`, `client.parse.run_job()`), and the quickstart says to use Python, Node.js, or Go examples. This indicates official SDK usage across several languages, but the evidence never names the SDK packages, gives install instructions, or provides SDK reference docs. Coverage of the story is therefore incomplete. missing for 10: explicit naming of official SDK packages per language, install and versioning docs, SDK reference documentation, independent or hands-on corroboration of SDK quality.
